description: KML (Kerbal Markup Lister): save file editor for Kerbal Space Program. Shows .sfs saves and .craft files as a tree, lists vessels, kerbals and how parts are attached, repairs broken docking ports and contracts; GUI and command line.
notes: Edit a save with KSP closed: the game writes persistent.sfs itself and would overwrite the changes.
Every save in KML renames the previous file to zKMLBACKUP<date><time>-<name> in the same folder.
Those backups are never deleted; remove old ones by hand.
Command line: 'kml' switches to it when given any dashed option, for example
Without an option, 'kml <file>' opens the window, and the shell waits until it is closed.
On start the window asks GitHub for a newer release and shows an orange link if there is one:
Saves under %ProgramFiles(x86)% (a Steam library in the default place) need admin rights to overwrite;
KML warns about that when it opens such a file.
